title: Microbial DNA Isolation from Soil Samples
author: Paula Harkes

steps.title: Prepare Soil Sample
steps.instruction: Weigh 1 gram of thoroughly mixed soil, transfer it to a 15 mL bead tube, and add 1.5 gram of silicon carbide powder (grit 46).

steps.title: Add Lysis Reagents
steps.instruction: Add 3 mL of bead solution C0 and 0.24 mL of lysis buffer C1 to the tube.

substeps.instruction: If solution C1 is precipitated, heat to max. 60 °C until the precipitate has dissolved before use.

steps.title: Bead Beat Samples
steps.instruction: Bead beat the tubes for 10 minutes using a paint shaker or a vortex.

steps.title: Separate Soil Particles
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes for 2-5 minutes at 2,500 x g and 4°C to separate soil particles from the lysate.

steps.title: First Nucleic Acid Precipitation
steps.instruction: Transfer 2 mL of the upper aqueous phase to a new 15 mL tube, add 1 mL of solution C2, and hand mix for approximately 1 minute.

steps.title: Separate First Precipitate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes for 2-5 minutes at 2,500 x g and 4°C to separate the precipitate from the nucleic acids.

steps.title: Second Nucleic Acid Precipitation
steps.instruction: Transfer 2.6 mL of the upper aqueous phase to a new 15 mL tube, add 0.8 mL of Solution C3, and shake by hand for 1 minute to mix.

substeps.instruction: Optional: Samples can be incubated at 4°C for longer than 5 minutes (up to 12 hours) without significant loss of DNA yield or purity.

steps.title: Separate Second Precipitate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes for 2-5 minutes at 2,500 x g and 4°C to separate the precipitate from the nucleic acids.

steps.title: Collect Supernatant
steps.instruction: Avoiding the pellet, transfer a fixed volume (e.g., 1 mL) of supernatant into a clean 1.5-15 mL tube.

steps.title: Bind DNA to Spin Columns
steps.instruction: Add 2 volumes of binding solution C4a or C4b at room temperature (RT) to the supernatant and shake by hand to mix.

substeps.instruction: Spin for a few seconds to pellet the toxic droplets.
Load samples onto Biocomma spin columns (capacity ~20 μg).
Process using a vacuum manifold or centrifuge for 30 seconds at ~10,000 x g.
If sample volume exceeds filter volume, repeat the loading process.

steps.title: Wash DNA Sample
steps.instruction: Add 0.5 mL of washing solution C5 to the pall plate or spin filter column.

substeps.instruction: This step may be repeated up to 3 additional times for a cleaner sample.

steps.title: Dry the Pellet
steps.instruction: Remove waste and perform one extra spin step for 30 seconds at ~10,000 x g to dry the pellet.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Air-dry the filter for 5 minutes, place a collection plate under the vacuum manifold, and add 0.2 mL of elution buffer C6 to the pall plate or column.

steps.title: Store Eluate
steps.instruction: Collect the 0.2 mL eluate and store it at -20 °C until further use.
